In [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]], there was a '''duel on Courkrus''' between [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] and members of the [[Jensaarai/Legends|Jensaarai]]. Part-way through the duel, Horn received support from [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]. The Jensaarai were quickly defeated by the two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].

==Prelude==
In order to track down his [[Mirax Terrik Horn|wife]] kidnapped by former [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Leonia Tavira]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] infiltrated one of Tavira's [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]], the [[Khuiumin Survivors]]. He then [[Mission to Courkrus|haunted]] the [[Invids]] on [[Courkrus]], disguising himself as a Jedi Knight.

==The duel==
Tavira dispatched [[Kelbis Nu]] and four other [[Jensaarai/Legends|Jensaarai]] to apprehend Horn. They tracked him down on Courkrus and trapped him by night in an alley, unaffected by the [[Mind trick/Legends|Force illusions]] he conjured against them. Just as the other Jensaarai were about to attack Horn, however, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] arrived&mdash;guided by the [[Gand/Legends|Gand]] [[Ooryl Qrygg]]&mdash;and helped Horn fight the Jensaarai. While three of the Jensaarai attacked Skywalker, Nu and another fought against Horn. Horn quickly defeated them both, catching Nu by the wrist and knocking him out with a blow from the end of his lightsaber pommel to the right side of his head.

==Aftermath==
Using a [[Ysalamiri/Legends|ysalamir]] to confuse the Jensaari, as well as the presence of Skywalker as intimidation, Horn interrogated the Jensaarai until they revealed their origins and the location of Tavira's base. The Jedi immediately departed to [[Susevfi]] in order to [[Battle of Susevfi|rescue]] Mirax.
